name_zh: 感觉运动同步（节拍器敲击）
aliases: sensorimotor synchronization; synchronization-continuation tapping; syncopation/synchronization task; SMS
lead_titles: Mayville JM. Neural correlates of human sensorimotor coordination: EEG, MEG, and functional MRI. Florida Atlantic University (dissertation). 2000. | Differential contributions of the two human cerebral hemispheres to action timing. eLife. 2019.
note: 收录（建议）；已建骨架文件 paradigms/motor/MOT-SMS-001.yaml。Distinct from SSR-BEAT-001 (beat perception, package A), SOC-JA-001 (interpersonal tapping, package E) and MOT-BIMAN-001; paced tapping as a motor localizer is a MOT-ME-001 variant. Leads N12 (dissertation) and N13 (title only).

name_zh: 被动运动（本体感觉刺激）
aliases: passive movement; proprioceptive stimulation; corticokinematic coherence paradigm; CKC
lead_titles: Bourguignon M, Piitulainen H, De Tiege X, Jousmaki V, Hari R. Corticokinematic coherence mainly reflects movement-induced proprioceptive feedback. NeuroImage 106:382-390. 2015.
note: 收录（建议）；已建骨架文件 paradigms/motor/MOT-PASS-001.yaml。Requests new marker MK.corticokinematic_coherence (marker_requests.csv). Passive movements also appear as a comparison condition in R0922 (MOT-ATT-001).

name_zh: Libet 意图时刻判断任务
aliases: Libet task; W judgement; conscious intention timing; Libet clock task
lead_titles: Libet B, Gleason CA, Wright EW, Pearl DK. Time of conscious intention to act in relation to onset of cerebral activity (readiness-potential): the unconscious initiation of a freely voluntary act. Brain 106(3):623-642. 1983.
note: 收录（建议）；已建骨架文件 paradigms/motor/MOT-LIBET-001.yaml。Shares MK.MRCP with MOT-MRCP-001 but probes the construct of conscious intention; separate from MOT-IB-001 (perceived action-outcome timing). Maintainer to decide independence vs variant.

aliases: smooth pursuit; pursuit eye movements; ocular pursuit
lead_titles: Petit L, Haxby JV. Functional anatomy of pursuit eye movements in humans as revealed by fMRI. Journal of Neurophysiology. 1999.
note: 收录（建议）；已建骨架文件 paradigms/motor/MOT-PURS-001.yaml。Separate oculomotor system from saccades (MOT-SACC-001); maintainer may consider it a variant.

aliases: postural perturbation; perturbation-evoked potential; PEP; support-surface perturbation
lead_titles: Varghese JP, Marlin A, Beyer KB, Staines WR, Mochizuki G, McIlroy WE. Frequency characteristics of cortical activity associated with perturbations to upright stability. Neuroscience Letters 578:33-38. 2014.
note: 收录（建议）；已建骨架文件 paradigms/motor/MOT-PERT-001.yaml。Requests new marker MK.perturbation_N1. The lead found (N04) is a frequency-domain study; an origin paper for the perturbation N1 is still needed. Latency in the description is textbook-level and awaits source checking.

aliases: mirror therapy; mirror visual feedback; mirror box illusion; MVF
lead_titles: Chang C-S, Lo Y-Y, Chen C-L, Lee H-M, Chiang W-C, Li P-C. Alternative motor task-based pattern training with a digital mirror therapy system enhances sensorimotor signal rhythms post-stroke. Frontiers in Neurology 10:1227. 2019.
note: 收录（建议）；已建骨架文件 paradigms/motor/MOT-MVF-001.yaml。Distinct from MOT-MIRR-001 (mirror tracing, reversed visuomotor mapping) and MOT-OBS-001. Lead N14 is a stroke-rehabilitation study; origin paper not yet identified.

aliases: tactile imagery; somatosensory imagery; imagined touch; imagined vibration
lead_titles: Yakovlev L, Syrov N, Miroshnikov A, Lebedev M, Kaplan A. Event-related desynchronization induced by tactile imagery: an EEG study. eNeuro 10(6):ENEURO.0455-22.2023. 2023.
note: 收录（建议）；已建骨架文件 paradigms/imagery/IMG-TACT-001.yaml。Differs from IMG-SAO-001, where attention is directed to real stimulation.

aliases: odor imagery; odour mental imagery; olfactory mental imagery
lead_titles: Djordjevic J, et al. Functional neuroimaging of odor imagery. NeuroImage 24:791-801. 2005. | Royet JP, Delon-Martin C, Plailly J. Odor mental imagery in non-experts in odors: a paradox? Frontiers in Human Neuroscience. 2013.
note: 收录（建议）；已建骨架文件 paradigms/imagery/IMG-OLF-001.yaml。New candidate (pkg B), low BCI relevance (classic cognitive-neuroscience paradigm). first_source N06 is known only from the reference list of N07 (secondary citation; must be checked against the original). Requests new marker MK.BOLD_olfactory_cortex.

note: 收录（建议）；已建骨架文件 paradigms/stimulation/STM-TAVNS-001.yaml。Uses MK.P3b (owner package A). Vagus somatosensory evoked potentials (VSEP) could be requested later as a separate marker.

aliases: adaptive DBS; aDBS; closed-loop DBS; beta-triggered DBS

lead_titles: Non-invasive temporal interference electrical stimulation of the human hippocampus. Nature Neuroscience.
note: 收录（建议）；已建骨架文件 paradigms/stimulation/STM-TI-001.yaml。Lead N11 confirmed only title and journal; authors/year to be completed.

aliases: closed-loop acoustic stimulation; CLAS; phase-locked auditory stimulation; acoustic slow-wave enhancement
lead_titles: Ngo HVV, Martinetz T, Born J, Mölle M. Auditory closed-loop stimulation of the sleep slow oscillation enhances memory. Neuron 78(3):545-553. 2013.
note: 收录（建议）；已建骨架文件 paradigms/stimulation/STM-CLAS-001.yaml。Uses MK.slow_wave and MK.sleep_spindle (owner package D). Family (stimulation vs state) and relation to MEM-TMR-001 (memory cues during sleep) to be confirmed by the maintainer.

aliases: GVS; galvanic vestibular stimulation; vestibular electrical stimulation
lead_titles: Bense S, Stephan T, Yousry TA, Brandt T, Dieterich M. Multisensory cortical signal increases and decreases during vestibular galvanic stimulation (fMRI). Journal of Neurophysiology. 2001.

lead_titles: Zrenner C, Desideri D, Belardinelli P, Ziemann U. Real-time EEG-defined excitability states determine efficacy of TMS-induced plasticity in human motor cortex. Brain Stimulation 11(2):374-389. 2018.
note: 收录（建议）；已建骨架文件 paradigms/stimulation/STM-PHTMS-001.yaml。The outcome measure in the lead is the motor evoked potential (EMG); the brain marker is the mu-rhythm state used for triggering (MK.SMR_ERD). Maintainer may prefer a dedicated phase marker.
